placeholder.label: Inside the Great Hall: looking down the hall to the hirdmaster on the high seat (centre), the steward by an open chest (left foreground), the lawspeaker with a staff (right foreground). Each person whole, with clear space around them.
The Smithy: the smith at his anvil under an open-sided shelter (centre), the forge glowing behind, the village, fjord and mountains beyond.
The Shipyard: a half-planked hull on stocks on the strand, the master shipwright in front of it (right foreground), finished ships and a boat shed at the left.
The Market: a merchant standing beside his trestle table in an awning-roofed booth, goods around him, a trading ship at the jetty behind.
Inside the Mead-hall by firelight: the hall-keeper by the ale vat (right foreground), two travellers at a bench (left), hired fighters in the shadows (centre back).
Inside the family Longhouse: hearth, sleeping benches, a loom, a hound; an elder of the household standing by the fire (centre).
Inside the Seer's hut: dark turf walls, embers, hanging herbs; the seer seated beside her table with a staff (centre).
The Sacred Grove on a misty morning: old trees, seven carved god-posts, a flat altar stone; the grove-keeper standing at the right.

The home village in fjord country on a clear summer day, seen from the water: the great hall in the centre, longhouse left, mead-hall right, shipyard and ships lower left, market and jetty at the bottom centre, smithy lower right, seer's hut high right, sacred grove far left. Labels sit on each building.

The home village in lake and forest country on a clear summer day, seen from the lake: the eight buildings laid out as in the fjord village, pine and birch forest around, an iron furnace and charcoal mounds by the smithy, a red bog at the right.

The home village on a low green island by a busy strait on a windy summer day: the eight buildings laid out as in the fjord village, a long trading strand with two jetties, more ships drawn up on the sand at the lower left.
